metadata.challenge: NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026: Flame in Freefall
metadata.evidence_policy: Partial-gravity (0.16g Lunar, 0.38g Martian) results must always be labeled as theoretical bounds/interpolations because NASA PSI currently contains no direct partial-gravity combustion datasets.

metrics.flame_configuration: Normal diffusion flame (fuel issued into oxidizer ambient)

example_response.summary_text: Pure methane burning in standard air yields Z_st = 0.05495, positioning the Burke-Schumann flame sheet well toward the oxidizer side (r_f / r_b = 18.2 in pure diffusive limit) and promoting fuel-rich soot formation unless diluted.
